slots.jd.commercial-mechanical.about: Corliss Commercial Mechanical seeks a Senior HVAC Technician to service, repair and maintain heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems in commercial buildings in the Columbus, OH area. The position is on site, leads technicians on assigned jobs and serves as a point of contact for customers. Minimum requirements include extensive field experience and a refrigerant compliance credential. Preferred candidates also hold a state HVAC licence and controls training.
slots.jd.commercial-mechanical.duties:
Responsibilities
- Prepare accurate job estimates for customers, covering labour, materials and equipment.
- Plan and perform preventive maintenance visits on commercial heating and cooling systems.
- Diagnose and repair faults in furnaces, heat pumps, air handling equipment and controls.
- Train and supervise apprentices on safe work practices and service procedures.
- Review completed work and keep work orders and service records up to date.
slots.jd.commercial-mechanical.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 8 or more years of experience as an HVAC technician.
- Refrigerant handling and leak testing skills, with a current Refrigerant Compliance Certificate (required).
- Furnace repair, thermostat installation and electrical testing on commercial equipment.
- Building automation knowledge, including troubleshooting controls and sensors.
- Preferred: a state HVAC technician licence and formal controls training.
slots.r1.b1: Install heat pumps and furnaces, using brazing and soldering on refrigerant lines, and have cut callbacks on new installations by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Prepare job estimates for customers that cover building automation controls alongside equipment, labour and materials.
slots.r1.b3: Diagnose heating and cooling faults and carry out furnace repair on site, reducing repeat visits by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Schedule service calls for the crew and assign technicians trained in refrigerant handling to jobs that involve recovery or recharging.
slots.r1.i1: Keeps accurate work orders for every service and installation job, recording parts, labour and findings for the office and customers.
slots.r1.i2: Leads preventive maintenance visits on customer heating and cooling systems, inspecting equipment and correcting problems before they cause breakdowns.
slots.r2.b1: Kept detailed work orders for heat pump service calls, cutting billing corrections by 45 percent through complete records of parts and labour.
slots.r2.b2: Performed leak testing on refrigerant circuits with pressure and electronic methods, locating faults before charging systems.
slots.r2.b3: Installed new heating and cooling equipment and set up preventive maintenance plans for each unit, lowering first-year service calls by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Estimated jobs for customers, using load calculations to size equipment correctly and price installations before work began.
slots.r2.i1: Carried out preventive maintenance visits on heating and cooling systems, cleaning, testing and adjusting equipment for reliable operation.
slots.r2.i2: Tested systems for refrigerant leaks during service and installation work, then repaired and verified each joint before recharging.
slots.r3.b1: Assisted in diagnosing heating and cooling faults and repaired failed joints through brazing and soldering, reducing rework on line repairs by 25 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Joined preventive maintenance visits and checked building automation settings and sensor readings under the direction of senior technicians.
slots.r3.b3: Kept work orders for furnace repair jobs up to date, cutting missing-part delays by 40 percent through accurate parts records.
slots.r3.b4: Tested systems for leaks and practised refrigerant handling for recovery and evacuation under the supervision of licensed technicians.
slots.r3.i1: Supported senior technicians in testing heating and cooling systems for leaks while learning safe refrigerant practices.
slots.r3.i2: Helped install heating and cooling equipment, from setting units to running lines and connecting controls, while completing apprenticeship training.
slots.summary.1: Senior HVAC technician with 8 years of experience planning jobs and checking the work of other technicians on heating and cooling projects. Skilled in heat pump service, preventive maintenance and leak testing, with current refrigerant compliance and controls certifications.
slots.summary.2: Heating and cooling service professional with 8 years in the trade, from apprenticeship to senior technician. Plans jobs, reviews the work of others and brings hands-on strength in heat pump service, preventive maintenance and leak testing.
